v2_activity.past_cap: No cap reached: account B walked 21 pages (20 x 1000 + 490) = 20,490 rows ASC and 20,490 rows DESC; ASC first ts 1765400032 = DESC last ts, ASC last ts 1795458127 = DESC first ts. v2_trades.sort: newest first only; sort_direction=ASC is ignored (first row stays newest)

v2_trades.time_filters: start/end work (47 rows in a 100,000 s window, has_more false)
v2_trades.fields: proxy_wallet, side, token_id, condition_id, size, price, timestamp, title, slug, outcome, outcome_index, transaction_hash (+ profile fields). No fee, no maker/taker flag, no log index, no usdc amount
v2_trades.coverage_cross_check: A: 1,753 trades == 1,753 activity TRADE rows (2 pages); B: 17,247 trades == 17,247 activity TRADE rows (18 pages). The user-scoped trade feed equals activity TRADE count (count match only, rows not compared one by one)

v2_positions.status_values: OPEN (returns rows whose status shows REDEEMABLE: 701 for A), REDEEMABLE, CLOSED (963 for A, 8,925 for B in 9 pages); ALL, RESOLVED, BOGUS -> HTTP 400 'invalid position status'
v2_positions.sort_by: CURRENT_VALUE (OPEN default), REALIZED_PNL (CLOSED default), TIMESTAMP accepted; BOGUS -> 400 'invalid position sortBy'
v2_positions.time_filters: start/end accepted on status=CLOSED (rows returned had last_event_at inside the window); full semantics not verified
v2_positions.fields: token_id, condition_id, avg_price, entry_cost_usdc, entry_fees_usdc, realized_pnl, total_pnl, first_entry_at, last_event_at, status, redeemable, negative_risk, end_date

subgraphs.polymarket_goldsky: All five known Goldsky public endpoints (orderbook, activity, positions, pnl, oi; versions 0.0.x and 'prod') return HTTP 429 with GraphQL error 'This Polymarket subgraph endpoint is paused and deprecated following Polymarket's migration to V2 - the data is stale and incorrect. Stop using it.' (code ENDPOINT_DEPRECATED, migrateTo https://edge.goldsky.com/data/docs/). _meta and a known-fill query could not be run. The URL paths were from my recall of older docs; current docs.polymarket.com/llms.txt (17,207 bytes) has no subgraph/goldsky mention
subgraphs.goldsky_edge_data_api: https://edge.goldsky.com/data/polymarket/{activity,balances,positions}: unauthenticated call -> HTTP 402 x402 'Payment required' (amount 5000 USDC base units on eip155:8453, i.e. 0.005 USDC per call; OpenAPI also lists an API key). Paid/keyed -> excluded by the no-paid-services rule, not queried further

Polymarket/polymarket-subgraph.note: README gives only localhost graph-node and 'goldsky subgraph deploy'

psyberck/polymarket-subgraph-v2.description: Envio HyperIndex indexer, self-hosted (Postgres/ClickHouse, Parquet checkpoints, optional RPC proxy). Entities UserPosition ({user}-{tokenId}: balance, avg price, fees, realized PnL, total bought), OrderFilled ({blockNumber}-{logIndex}), Condition, OutcomeToken, NegRiskEvent. README claims 97.76% of positions match the Data API exactly and 98.60% match or differ by dust/convention (author claim, not re-measured)

enviodev/polymarket-v2-indexer.description: Envio HyperIndex; README: 'A HyperSync API token is required'. Lists exchanges 0xe11118..., 0xe2222d...0f59, 0xe2222d...0036 (ExchangeV3 0xe33337... not listed). Entities OrderFill (maker, taker, side, tokenId, fee, builder code), OrderMatch, FeeEvent, Market, PolyUSD*, Ctf*, Sponsorship*

subgraphs.pagination_limits: not measurable: no live public endpoint for any of the three
